quote: Liwathon Group … announce that the Board of Directors of the Export-Import Bank of the United States (EXIM) has approved a final commitment loan guarantee exceeding $71.3 million. This significant financial backing will support the relaunch of the 1.1 million m3 South Riding Point energy terminal in the Bahamas later this year, operated by Liwathon B.O.S. LLC. The loan guarantee marks one of the largest financial commitments by EXIM for a project in The Caribbean Community (CARICOM).
note: Opened Liwathon English release 16 Oct 2023 (EXIM >USD 71.3m South Riding Point).
